text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Twinkle Twinkle! ☆ O power of the
moon, power
my legs!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, perfect. ♪ The way things are
going, the
Shuka Sho's gonna be no
problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna find that racing magic in no
time at
all...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Is it really gonna be that easy?)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: I'm winning this! I am!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Oaks Racer A
text_block_list.text: You're! Not! Beating! Me! GRAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Oaks Racer B
text_block_list.text: Get away from my throne!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! The Shuka Sho's gonna be
even more
intense!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Which means I've gotta step it up too...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to the training track and find an

intimidating Sweep Tosho waiting for
me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Boooooring!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's the deal, Familiar?! And what's
our
training regimen for the week?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Aaagh! Nope! That is not gonna work!
choice_data_list: It's the same training as usual, but...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Look at this, Familiar! This is the special magic I need right now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"One: Magic to become faster than
anyone! Run
while basking in the power
of the setting sun! This
must be
continued for a full week!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Two: Magic to attain perfect
concentration!
Watch a whole bunch of
past races and absorb
the runners'
magical energy!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And! And!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho continues explaining the
"special"
magic she's written about in her
notebook.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I worked any single part of it into her
training
regimen, it'd probably take her
a full day.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna cast all of this special magic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it looks like we'll be
training nonstop
for two weeks straight.
Even if I schedule some
breaks, she
won't have time to do anything else...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If you know what to do, then hurry up
and get
prepping. That's your job, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna master all of this magic! And
then I'm
gonna take first place in the
Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There's no way anyone else is winning on
my
watch! After all, there's no beating
my racing
magic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her eyes are blazing with determination.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we're going to turn that special magic
she's
filled her notebook with into a
reality, we'll have
to train all day, every
day, for a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I'm sure that for every day of effort
we put in,
her performance at the Shuka
Sho will turn out
even better.
